title: OTLP -> Prometheus metrics adapter and KPI rollup for inference services
creator: Morgan Lee
description: Build a lightweight metrics adapter service that ingests OpenTelemetry/OTLP metric streams from inference runtime components, normalizes labels and cardinality, converts histograms/exemplars into Prometheus-compatible metrics, and emits derived inference KPIs (e.g., effective_tokens_per_second, p50/p90/p99 tail latencies, kv_cache_hit_rate) to our Prometheus federation layer. The adapter should attach trace exemplars (trace_id/span_id) where available and expose a backpressure-safe export path to the existing Prometheus scraping endpoint as well as to long-term metrics storage for historical KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter ingests OTLP metric and exemplar payloads from runtime and gateway components without loss under nominal load
Label normalization and cardinality enforcement configured by policy and validated with test harness (max 15 dynamic labels per metric by default)
Histograms from runtime are converted to Prometheus histograms or summaries preserving bucket semantics and exemplars are attached to latency metrics
Derived KPIs (tokens/s, kv_cache_hit_rate, request_success_rate) are emitted with documented metric names and units and show consistent values for production workloads
Adapter exposes a health endpoint and metrics about dropped/aggregated series; unit and integration tests cover edge cases
Migration runbook and canary plan exist; rollout to staging and Dedicated environments completed with no SLO regressions
tasks: Design label canonicalization rules and cardinality budget
Implement OTLP receiver with configurable batching and backpressure
Prometheus exporter + metrics about adapter itself
Integration tests (synthetic runtime load, high-cardinality attack simulation)
Grafana dashboard templates and alert rules for new KPIs
Create migration runbook and staged rollout plan
comments: 2025-08-13 - Morgan Lee: Drafted design doc in Confluence (LINK: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INF-Metrics-Adapter). Focus areas: label trimming, histogram bucket reuse, and exemplar forwarding.
2025-08-20 - Avery Chen: Reviewed design. Concern: derived KPI computation window must be configurable per route to avoid smoothing away spikes. Suggested 5s/30s/5m windows.
2025-09-02 - Nikhil Rao (PM): Please include migration steps for Dedicated customers who rely on node-exporter style metrics. We need backward-compatible metric names for 3 months.
2025-09-10 - Infra team (Elena Garcia): Suggest adding TLS+mTLS for OTLP ingestion from on-prem/private runtime agents. We'll provide certificates via SOPS-managed secrets.

2025-09-18 - Engineering review: Implemented prototype receiver and label canonicalizer (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-adapter/pull/87). Initial benchmarks show ~1.2M series/min with 200ms median processing latency on a c5.4xlarge-like instance.

2025-09-24 - QA: Integration tests show a spike in series dropped when high-cardinality tag 'session_id' is present. Added transform rule to drop session_id by default unless flagged by route allowlist.
2025-09-30 - Observability: Dashboard templates committed (Grafana folder id: 8423). Alert rules for KPI regressions added to alerting repo (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/212).
